title: $4 Vs. $24 Vegan Sandwich

summary: Goodful’s video stages a side-by-side sandwich showdown: a budget-friendly $4 vegan sandwich versus a premium $24 vegan sandwich, with a guest taste-test to decide which option delivers the best value. The cheap build centers on marinated tofu, a mushroom pate, crisp fried tofu, cucumber, cabbage slaw, pickles, and a vegan chipotle mayo, assembled with a budget-minded approach. The splurgeworthy version layers a basil pesto infused with truffle oil, roasted red pepper spread, olive tapenade, and plant-based meats and cheeses (prosciutto, carpaccio, Yoko’s mozzarella, provolone), finished with arugula and melted vegan cheese. Tucker samples both and weighs flavor complexity against price to determine the better value, while Merle and Rachel invite viewers to suggest future challenges. The video blends cooking tactics with a light-value comparison format and ends with audience engagement prompts.

sections.title: Intro and format: $4 vs $24 vegan sandwiches
sections.description: Merle and Rachel introduce the challenge: build two vegan sandwiches at distinct price points and have Tucker judge which offers the best value. They announce a coin flip to assign which budget is labeled as expensive vs cheap.

sections.title: Budget-friendly four-dollar sandwich: tofu marinade and mushroom pate
sections.description: Plan for the cheap sandwich includes marinating extra-firm tofu in a soy-based bath, preparing a mushroom pate, and crisping tofu slices with cornstarch before assembling with cucumber, slaw, pickles, and vegan mayo.

sections.title: Premium twenty-four-dollar sandwich: pesto, spreads, and plant-based meats
sections.description: The expensive build centers on a truffle-oil pesto, a roasted red pepper spread, olive-topped tapenade, and deli-style vegan slices (prosciutto, carpaccio) plus vegan cheeses and arugula, assembled and toasted with melted cheese.

sections.title: Tasting and verdict: value judgment and audience prompt
sections.description: Tucker samples both sandwiches, comments on flavors and texture, and declares which sandwich offers better value. The hosts invite viewers to share ideas for future challenges in the comments.

sections.title: Closing and credits
sections.description: Brief sign-off and prompt for audience interaction as the episode ends.
